sections.description: Step-by-step guides for building with Loopstack — getting started, workflow fundamentals, AI/LLM integration, workflow patterns, and third-party integrations.

sections.title: Registry
sections.description: The Loopstack Registry — a curated collection of npm packages providing LLM providers, agents, tools, OAuth integrations, workspace runtime and Studio surfaces.

sections.title: Registry — Packages
sections.description: Official Loopstack packages providing LLM providers, OAuth, human-in-the-loop, Git/GitHub tools, Docker sandboxes, secrets management, and more.

sections.description: Example workflows demonstrating Loopstack patterns: chat, tool calling, agents, HITL, structured output, sub-workflows, and integrations. One runnable app, one module per theme.
